title: VK-only Read Holding Registers minimal quantity
purpose: Probe the smallest ordinary register-read quantity while maintaining a fully consistent request length and a conventional address field.
expected_behavior: The server should parse the request as a valid one-register Read Holding Registers operation and return two data bytes or a protocol-level exception.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches the unit identifier plus the five-byte request PDU.
Quantity is the valid single-register boundary value 0001.
Hex is lowercase with no separators.
issue_safety_notes: This remains a valid boundary candidate rather than a malformed overflow reproducer; it does not copy historical crash bytes or claim the cited issue behavior is verified here.
